name: Fancy Post Grid – Ultimate Post Grid Builder
author: RSTheme

sections.description:
Fancy Post Grid – Ultimate Post Grid Builder is a complete blog layout and site builder solution for WordPress.

Create responsive post grids, sliders, and dynamic blog layouts using Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, or flexible shortcodes — all from a single plugin.

The built-in Elementor Site Builder lets you design headers, footers, mega menus, popups, off-canvas panels, archive pages, single post templates, page title sections, and 404 pages visually.

Version 2.0 introduces a fully modular, class-based architecture with optimized asset loading, centralized sanitization, and improved performance for content-heavy websites.

Perfect for blogs, magazines, news portals, and dynamic content sites.

Key Features

Elementor Integration

Free Widgets:

  • Heading – Customizable headings with typography and alignment controls
  • Button – Flexible call-to-action buttons with icons and hover effects
  • Icon Box – Icon with title and description in structured layout
  • Image – Responsive images with link and styling options
  • Divider – Styled separators to organize content sections
  • Date & Time – Dynamic post date, time, or modified date display
  • Social Share – Post share buttons for social platforms
  • Social Icons – Linked social profile icons with layout controls
  • Post Grid – Responsive post grid with query and layout options
  • Post Slider – Touch-enabled responsive post slider

Pro Widgets:

  • Post Group – Display posts grouped by taxonomy or custom query
  • Post Filter – AJAX-based category or taxonomy filters
  • Post Thumbnail Slider – Synced thumbnail and content slider
  • Post Categories – Styled category lists with counters
  • Post Ticker – News ticker for posts
  • Table of Content – Auto-generated table of contents from headings
  • Weather – Real-time weather display for selected location
  • Button Rotating – Animated rotating text button
  • Contact Form 7 – Style Contact Form 7 inside Elementor

Elementor Site Builder

Design full site layouts visually:

  • Header & Footer builder
  • Page Title section
  • Mega Menu
  • Popup builder
  • Off-Canvas panels
  • Archive templates
  • Single Post templates
  • 404 page templates

Site Builder Widgets:

  • Site Logo – Display site logo with responsive sizing
  • Mini Search – Compact search form with toggle option
  • Nav Menu – WordPress menu with mega menu support
  • Off-Canvas Toggle – Trigger off-canvas panels
  • Page Title – Dynamic page titles with breadcrumb support
  • Archive Posts – Archive listings with layout controls
  • Post Meta – Author, date, categories, and metadata output
  • Post Excerpt – Excerpt with length and read-more controls
  • Post Content – Full post content rendering
  • Featured Image – Post featured image with ratio controls
  • Post Comments – WordPress comments template
  • Post Author – Author name, avatar, and bio display
  • Post Navigation – Previous and next post links
  • Copyright – Dynamic copyright text output
  • Breadcrumb (Breadcrumb NavXT) – Breadcrumb navigation support

Gutenberg Blocks

  • Table of Content block – Auto-generate TOC from headings
  • Post Grid block – Coming soon
  • Post Slider block – Coming soon
  • More block coming soon

Shortcodes

  • Post Grid shortcode – Insert customizable post grid anywhere
  • Post Slider shortcode – Embed responsive post slider via shortcode
  • More layouts coming soon

Themes Using Fancy Post Grid

The following themes are built using Fancy Post Grid:

  • Nerio – News Magazine WordPress Theme

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor (optional, required only for Elementor widgets)

Support

Documentation and support:
https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/fancy-post-grid/
sections.installation:
Using the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Fancy Post Grid”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Uploading via Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload fancy-post-grid.x.x.x.zip
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Using FTP

  1. Extract fancy-post-grid.x.x.x.zip
  2. Upload the fancy-post-grid folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Elementor is required only for Elementor widgets and Site Builder features.

Can I use it with Gutenberg?

Yes. Gutenberg blocks are included and more are coming soon.

Does it slow down my website?

No. Assets are loaded only when a layout is used.

Can I filter posts by category or tag?

Yes. Advanced query controls are available in widgets and shortcodes.
